Package fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp2.impl

Class ElectricCar

java.lang.Object
fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp2.model.Vehicle
fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp2.model.MotorVehicle
fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp2.impl.ElectricCar
All Implemented Interfaces:
Drivable, Electric, Rechargeable
public class ElectricCar extends MotorVehicle implements Drivable, Electric, Rechargeable
Concrete Vehicle representing an electric car. Uses battery instead of fuel - demonstrates separation of concerns via ISP.
